The '''Battle of Altratonne''' was an engagement between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Alliance forces under [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Lav Bilsek]] engaged the Imperial [[IM-455 modular garrison|garrison]] on [[Altratonne]] in order to disrupt the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] relay in the sector.

The Rebels first attacked the [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]]. A second strike team then seized the landing bay. A third strike team infiltrates the back way and encounters Imperial surveyors.
